name: Gorham's Cave Complex
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Set in the sea-facing limestone cliffs of the Rock of Gibraltar, Gorham's Cave and its three neighbouring caves sheltered Neanderthals for over 100,000 years. Traces left behind include the remains of hunted birds and marine animals, feathers likely worn as decoration, and an abstract pattern carved into the rock. The cave now sits just metres from the Mediterranean, though it once lay about 5 km inland.
